The scene includes a single crop bed, thin installed drip laterals, neutral seedlings, and natural soil conditions aligned with the article’s agronomy focus. Minor visual details like small secondary fine print or exact clearance from the installed lines are advisory and do not affect the core validity. No distinct additional loose coil or roll is present outside the required package. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail visibly protrudes from the carton's sides or base.
